input.title: Two Similar Transfers
input.request: Mira, the account holder, wants H&V to establish whether two similar outgoing transfer entries are one instruction shown twice or two separate instructions, and asks whether the second can be stopped or returned.

events.text: Your payment activity shows two similar outgoing transfer entries to North Quay Utilities for £84.20. One is marked Completed and the other Pending.
I own this account and only meant to make one transfer. Please check whether these are separate instructions, and whether the pending one has been stopped or returned.
I’m checking the count and independent instruction references for Mira’s own payment instructions before advising. I have not cancelled or returned either instruction.

summary: Mira Ellison, writing over secure chat and not verified, asked whether her two similar transfers were separate instructions and whether the pending one had been stopped or returned. The desk classified it as a transfer question and put the case in WAITING for the payment system's answer, which has not come in. Its later attempts to ask the payment system again and to escalate were both refused because the case was no longer in the TRIAGED state, so nothing has been stopped, returned or changed, and no one has been handed the case through the desk. Her identity still needs verifying and the payment records still need checking, and the record shows no person assigned to do either.

args.note: Mira Ellison (unverified, secure chat) reports two similar outgoing transfers to North Quay Utilities for £84.20, one Completed and one Pending. She says she intended only one and asks whether they are separate instructions and whether the pending one can be stopped or returned. The payment records check is refused: the case is in WAITING state, not TRIAGED, and payment_asked is already true, so no payment record is in the case. Please verify her identity, check the payment records to see whether this is one instruction shown twice or two, and then advise on stopping or returning the pending one. I have not stated or changed anything on the payment.
